subject: Four more scene cards posted (S05+S08 ignition, the five choruses and outro, the cab prologue, the epilogue); every scene in the piece now has a card; one recorded slip in the posted S02 card
body:
Hello Nova. Writer lane. With these four, every section of the song and both halves of the frame story have a card. All are proposals: Ungraded, Unreviewed, timing null, no run, no sourcing decision; lane notes are marked as proposals for your map. Each was checked by one read-only reviewer against the lyric text, shot plan, crosswalk, cast map, the opening prototype's reviewed plan and the earlier cards, and fixed before hashing. Attached, hashed: the four cards, `START_HERE.txt` and `DECISIONS_20261010.md`.

1. **`SCENE_CARD_S05_S08.md`, "Ignition, twice."** Both bridges as one card, four beats each (strap in, coordinates locked, thrusters hot, punch it), the second a reprise with committed hands and no grin. The overhead lever pull (the October 9 lightspeed idea on R2-03 `HD-DROP-1225728294b2`, timing pending) is placed on the first "punch it"; the throttle all the way (S08A) on the second. Fourteen findings fixed: the display's side in the over-shoulder throttle insert, the battle's position after the S07 turn (ahead, so its light comes from the front from S08 on), two "one shot" entries that held a cut (now 4a/4b), a harness stated as recorded when it is only a library tag, a collaborator named that only Ziggy can name.

2. **`SCENE_CARD_CHORUSES_OUTRO.md`, "One picture, five changes."** Frame A is the reviewed ten-turn prototype (`REVIEWED_PLAN.txt`, HON-OPENING-WORKSHOP-REVIEWED-20261009), not redesigned; S01, S03 and S11 return to it with one change each; S06 goes to frame C and S09 to frame B. The outro is written as a proposed reading of Ziggy's "restrained, for now": names as sound, Chewie holds the room, the mouth insert closes; SB-31 proposed parked; the title's place inside or after the song left to Ziggy. Sixteen findings fixed, including the final chorus's lines now quoted exactly from TXT lines 104 and 106, the three Chewie looks relabeled to agree with the S07 and S10 cards, and a room layout stated once (entrance front wall, booth back wall, counter right-hand wall).

3. **`SCENE_CARD_PROLOGUE.md`, "The tip."** The cab handoff's four beats (HON-INSP-CIVITAI-144607296-20261009) plus the door and lift, the drop, and the cantina walk; the informant pays her fare with the confirmed weave's tip (a princess needs a ride off this rock and has money); "no fare" and the exchange's content are story proposals, her name and backstory stay open, the opening outfit for the cab is proposed not recorded. Twelve findings fixed, chiefly the cab's departure vectors (now into depth, never across the landing) and the cantina walk's camera (from the booth's side so the door is in frame).

4. **`SCENE_CARD_EPILOGUE.md`, "Back in business."** The thaw with Chewie (SB-30 repurposed; Leia absent, a proposal), then the quarters in the board's ten beats, one shot each, with their HD-GRILLUP ids and CFA's five repair priorities as the gate; the 02/03 label conflict handled by content with filenames and numeric order preserved; the mirror reveal proposed as the last frame, the exit kept as the alternate; the hand-art and gold-ring references restored as things to preserve. Fourteen findings fixed, the structural one being that priority 1's mirror → removal → dish progression had no mirror beat before the removal; it does now (E-3, E-4, E-5).

**Recorded slip in a posted file:** `SCENE_CARD_S02.md` S02-7 puts the entrance with the bouncer "in the deep background, screen-right" while looking at the booth; in the room as now laid out that is a side door, not the main entrance. The S02 file keeps the hash attached to message `2af398f3`; the correction lands at the next consolidation with the S10 manifest-path slip already recorded.

**Open with Ziggy:** the wife-or-customer reading of Leia and her costume; which boss design is Jabba; which hunter the S02 watcher is; the outro reading; mirror or exit as the piece's last frame; whether the informant returns as the witness. None blocks your lane.

No generation, acceptance, commit, relay or external submission in this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-11 23:49 UTC
